source: GitHub repository metadata and source README as inspected on 2026-10-08
disclaimer: Original Prompt-Vault interactive studies are NOT vendor components. Do not conflate an MIT code license with rights to screenshots, trademarks, pro templates, external assets or data.

references.title: UI Promptly
references.byline: Compare complete design languages before committing.
references.summary: A gallery of 25 style systems with landing/dashboard iframe examples, raw prompts, and structured design specifications.
references.licenseNote: No root LICENSE file or explicit license statement was found on the inspected repository. Public visibility is not permission to redistribute its code or preview designs.
references.use: Reference-only. Link to its gallery; author independent styles and prompts.
references.designFocus: Make two visibly different interpretations of the same honest product brief: narrative landing and structured dashboard.
references.doNot: Do not reproduce the gallery source, brand visuals, font assets or iframe previews without separate permission.

references.title: Superdesign Prompts
references.byline: Prompt + design specification + honest visual proof.
references.summary: Research and use prompt-driven design specifications with associated previews and context instead of generic AI styling instructions.
references.licenseNote: Repository code and structure: MIT (LICENSE). Prompt content: CC0 1.0 (LICENSE-DATA). External app screenshots and generated outputs are not automatically covered.
references.use: Read CC0 prompts and cite provenance as useful; do not mirror gallery assets or assume all site functionality is open-source.
references.designFocus: Derive three incompatible visual structures from real product constraints, attach screen evidence and an originality rationale.
references.doNot: Do not blindly treat generated previews and vendor site assets as public domain.

references.title: Motion Primitives
references.byline: Animation that clarifies state and spatial continuity.
references.summary: Open motion components and interaction studies built around a React/Motion/Tailwind stack, with animated examples and documentation.
references.licenseNote: The repository README and root license document identify MIT for the public source. Fonts, demo images and external dependencies require separate verification.
references.use: Use existing MIT component code in downstream apps under its terms, or implement your own smaller focused transition.
references.designFocus: Create one expandable information disclosure and a motion-free equivalent, including keyboard focus and interruption.
references.doNot: Do not turn every component into a constantly moving ornament.

references.title: Uiverse Galaxy
references.byline: Tiny expressive controls with legitimate input behavior.
references.summary: Large collection of community-authored CSS/Tailwind UI elements covering toggles, buttons, loaders, inputs and form states.
references.licenseNote: Repository README explicitly describes UI element code under MIT. Verify the actual copied snippet and any independently sourced assets; attribution to the contributor is encouraged.
references.use: Select isolated MIT components where appropriate, preserving attribution notices and production accessibility.
references.bestFor: CSS inputs, toggles, loaders and switches
references.designFocus: Use one memorable toggle with meaningful contrast, state semantics and a keyboard-operated fallback.
references.doNot: Do not scatter unrelated community microeffects across one product screen.

references.title: Magic UI
references.byline: A memorable marketing moment without the gimmicks.
references.summary: Animated React components and page effects for marketing interfaces, product storytelling and branded sections.
references.licenseNote: Public repository root uses MIT; premium templates, separate artwork and paid products may have different terms.
references.use: Browse MIT components in official source and adapt sparingly to real product content.
references.designFocus: Make a product-value reveal triggered by a visitor action, not infinite glows, logos or count-up theater.
references.doNot: Do not fabricate social proof or copy a recognizable demo wholesale.

references.title: Origin UI
references.byline: Uncluttered application components with real semantics.
references.summary: Extensive React/Tailwind component patterns for web applications, including complex form and navigation controls.
references.licenseNote: GitHub repository lists MIT and README links to the source license. Verify each imported package, image and contribution for production reuse.
references.use: Use MIT components as implementation primitives, not as a substitute for task architecture or product identity.
references.bestFor: Web-app inputs, navigation and detail screens
references.designFocus: Build a clear form with inline errors, controlled state and a confirmation that does not imply a server request.
references.doNot: Do not confuse a component gallery with a coherent end-to-end app flow.

references.title: React Native Reusables
references.byline: Native-first behavior with a reusable component vocabulary.
references.summary: MIT React Native/Expo interface primitives and usage patterns inspired by the shadcn approach, with documentation and app-oriented examples.
references.licenseNote: GitHub root LICENSE and README identify MIT for the repository; assets and transitive dependencies may differ.
references.use: Use in a compatible Expo/NativeWind stack after platform, device and accessibility testing.
references.designFocus: Deliver a small mobile task experience with real tab states, pressed feedback and accessible names.
references.doNot: Do not pretend an HTML phone mockup establishes real iOS or Android parity.

references.title: gluestack-ui
references.summary: React Native and Expo copy-paste components, adaptable tokens and patterns spanning mobile and larger screens.
references.licenseNote: The README asserts MIT for v5 and links a root LICENSE, but a root LICENSE was not present in the observed repository listing. Verify the exact package/file license before redistributing.
references.use: Documentation and inspiration permitted as references; verify precise source file rights before copying into this MIT catalog.
references.bestFor: Expo/React Native responsive screens and patterns
references.designFocus: Show a mobile-list to spacious two-pane expansion without erasing navigation or losing focus.
references.doNot: Do not equate a responsive HTML mockup with tested native behavior.
